description: Shared project knowledge in Markdown and Git: complete startup manual, four focused procedures, topic records, pending-save recovery and verified publication.

interface.shortDescription: One Markdown project brain for agents and people.
interface.longDescription: Equips an opted-in project with one managed Knowledge manual, four focused procedures, topic memory, requirements, current work and a pending inbox. Three generated indexes make records and outside sources findable. Native agents evaluate meaning and permission; tools check structure and local/remote save evidence. Setup preserves records and reports actual host support separately.
